basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old music enthusiast from Atlanta, Georgia. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my passion for music, especially underground hip-hop and experimental sounds. I'm a huge fan of Pi'erre Bourne and love discussing music trends and album drops. I'm usually online late at night, often browsing through music-related subreddits and engaging in discussions. I'm single and spend most of my free time exploring new music, playing video games, and hanging out with friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep interest in music production and music trends, self-taught through online courses and YouTube tutorials. My background in graphic design helps me appreciate album artwork and promotional visuals, and I often analyze music videos and cover arts.
